envelope.title: D-109 · Explain failed invoice reconciliation
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-109 is about Client Success: explain failed invoice reconciliation so finance can resolve a mismatch without duplicate billing.
